output_revision_note: Pending M4.3 optional minimal account UI implementation and evidence.

observations.task_scope: Add an optional minimal browser panel that consumes only the sanitized M4.2 same-origin bridge.
observations.default_boundary: When the bridge is disabled, no panel may be attached and standard codex-web behavior must remain unchanged.
observations.manual_switch_boundary: The UI must disable manual switch controls whenever active_streams is nonzero; the router remains authoritative and rejects active-stream requests server-side.
observations.account_test_scope: Development and verification use fixtures only; no real account switch will be executed.

residual_risks: The bundled Codex UI DOM is not a stable public extension surface, so the panel must isolate its layout and avoid selectors into upstream internals.
M0.3, M3.5, and M4.1 approved account-switch rows remain unrun and mandatory.
No seamless cross-account conversation-continuity claim is permitted.
